verdict.rationale: Typesense ships a full REST API and official CLI (typesense-server) that were shown end-to-end creating a collection, indexing a document, and returning typo-tolerant search results with no dashboard or account involved (typesense-probe-rt-1, typesense-probe-rt-2), and Typesense explicitly publishes an 'AI Agents' guide plus an llms.txt describing itself as built 'for developers and AI agents' (typesense-docs-17, typesense-probe-1). This satisfies the API/CLI branch of the story even though no dedicated MCP server integration is documented in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: an official MCP server/tool integration, and deeper content confirming what the 'Typesense for AI Agents' guide actually covers beyond its title.
